title: Correct Dependabot intake hosted coverage regression
outOfScope: Modification of immutable archives for the failed predecessor Work Item.
Lowering the 85.10% coverage threshold or bypassing hosted checks.
Automatic merging of raw Dependabot pull requests.
Release publication and unrelated Issue remediation.

sources.reason: Corrective Issue records the hosted coverage failure, exact measured coverage, and authorized corrective scope.

Immutable predecessor Summary and local verification evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The correction re-delivers a fail-closed governance path and must restore hosted coverage without weakening project gates.

reasons: Corrective successor is a bounded code Work Item with explicit hosted verification.

executionDecision.reason: RayIori authorized automatic execution; this Contract constrains the corrective successor.

preReviewWarnings: Review direct coverage of every raw Dependabot intake decision branch.
Review successor lineage and ensure no predecessor archive or coverage threshold is modified.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: Fresh current-main successor implements the Dependabot intake behavior specified by the immutable #663 predecessor without modifying that predecessor's archive.
A2: Direct tests execute both raw Dependabot rejection and non-Dependabot/not-applicable check-script branches, and the aggregate coverage gate is at least 85.10% locally and hosted.
A3: The intake assessment remains fail-closed for raw locked-dependency and pinned-action candidates and never grants automatic merge authority.
A4: Intake and repository-workflow documentation describe successor evidence and the hosted verification requirement.
A5: Fresh hosted PR checks, including template-smoke and ci-evidence, pass before merge.
guidelines: Document any public Make target and operational intake behavior.
Keep intake helpers standalone; do not add cross-feature internal imports.
Preserve predecessor evidence immutably and record successor lineage.

intent.problem: Hosted template-smoke for #733 passed all 2,124 tests but failed total coverage at 85.08%, below 85.10%, because the new Dependabot check script was only 47.37% covered. The archived predecessor cannot be altered.
constraints: Use a fresh successor based on origin/main.
Do not weaken the coverage gate.
Do not mutate the archived predecessor or merge its failed PR.
Preserve fail-closed Dependabot behavior and require hosted verification.
intent.rationale: A narrow successor prevents post-archive evidence rewrite while fixing the exact hosted regression and retaining the original delivery intent.
